snippet.title: HeartLink // Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/2408750/HeartLink/

Star Fox meets Touhou in this action-packed sci-fi shoot 'em up, set to a rockin' synthwave soundtrack reminiscent of the Hotline Miami series. Pick one of five mech pilots and wield the eponymous HeartLinks to defend the Hydra Galaxy from the Omni invasion. Master yourself, master the machine.

Developed by
Serrated Studios aka @heartlink1726
